# App Store Compliance Playbook

> Reference index for App Store and Google Play submission checks. Confirm current requirements with official platform sources. A static scan covers selected risks and has limited evidence about a submitted build or listing.

## Core
- [Pre-submission checklist](https://github.com/RENEGADE21AI/app-store-compliance/blob/main/docs/PRE-SUBMISSION-CHECKLIST.md): every check before you submit
- [Apple rejection map](https://github.com/RENEGADE21AI/app-store-compliance/blob/main/docs/APPLE.md): guideline, trigger and fix
- [Google Play rejection map](https://github.com/RENEGADE21AI/app-store-compliance/blob/main/docs/GOOGLE-PLAY.md): policy, trigger and fix
- [Root causes and appeal playbook](https://github.com/RENEGADE21AI/app-store-compliance/blob/main/docs/MISTAKE-PATTERNS.md)
- [Rejection map by app type](https://github.com/RENEGADE21AI/app-store-compliance/blob/main/docs/BY-APP-TYPE.md)

## Law
